arxiv-2205-15091.title: Neutron star crust properties: comparison between the compressible liquid-drop model and the extended Thomas-Fermi approach
arxiv-2205-15091.creator: G. Grams, J. Margueron and R. Somasundaram, N. Chamel and S. Goriely
arxiv-2205-15091.description: Abstract We present a detailed analysis of three models predicting the properties of non-uniform matter in the crust of neutron stars: the compressible liquid-drop model, the fourth order Extended Thomas Fermi (ETF) method, and ETF plus Strutinsky integral (ETFSI) correction.

arxiv-2307-00296.title: Accelerated primal-dual methods with enlarged step sizes and operator learning for nonsmooth optimal control problems Thanks: July 24, 2023
arxiv-2307-00296.creator: Yongcun Song, Xiaoming Yuan, Hangrui Yue
arxiv-2307-00296.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yongcun Song, Xiaoming Yuan, Hangrui Yue. We consider a general class of nonsmooth optimal control problems with partial differential equation (PDE) constraints, which are very challenging due to their nonsmooth objective functionals and the resulting high-dimensional and ill-conditioned systems after discretization. We focus on the application of a primal-dual method, with which different types of variables can be treated individually in iterations and thus its main computation at each iteration only requires solving two PDEs.

Nevertheless, two such objects have been discovered in gravitational-wave data from LIGO and Virgo.

arxiv-2310-06294.title: The Constraining Capability of BNS Dark Sirens Observed by the LIGO Gravitational Wave Detector on the Hubble Constant
arxiv-2310-06294.creator: Xu Chao
arxiv-2310-06294.description: Abstract Abstract The Hubble Constant observed at high redshift and low redshift are inconsistent, representing one of the urgent issues to be resolved in the field of cosmology. The discovery of gravitational waves opens a new window for addressing this problem.

arxiv-2412-05643.title: Hydrodynamic density-functional theory for the moving contact-line problem reveals fluid structure and emergence of a spatially distinct pattern.
arxiv-2412-05643.creator: Andreas Nold, Benjamin D. Goddard, David N. Sibley, Serafim Kalliadasis
arxiv-2412-05643.description: Abstract Understanding the nanoscale effects controlling the dynamics of a contact line – defined as the line formed at the junction of two fluid phases and a solid – has been a longstanding problem in fluid mechanics pushing experimental and numerical methods to their limits.

arxiv-2412-08169.title: Illusory VQA: Benchmarking and Enhancing Multimodal Models on Visual Illusions
arxiv-2412-08169.creator: Mohammadmostafa Rostamkhani, Baktash Ansari, Hoorieh Sabzevari, Farzan Rahmani, Sauleh Eetemadi
arxiv-2412-08169.description: Abstract In recent years, Visual Question Answering (VQA) has made significant strides, particularly with the advent of multimodal models that integrate vision and language understanding. However, existing VQA datasets often overlook the complexities introduced by image illusions, which pose unique challenges for both human perception and model interpretation.

arxiv-2512-11139.title: Autotune: fast, accurate, and automatic tuning parameter selection for Lasso
arxiv-2512-11139.creator: Tathagata Sadhukhan, Ines Wilms, Stephan Smeekes, Sumanta Basu
arxiv-2512-11139.description: Abstract Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (Lasso), a popular method for high-dimensional regression, is now used widely for estimating high-dimensional time series models such as the vector autoregression (VAR). Selecting its tuning parameter efficiently and accurately remains a challenge, despite the abundance of available methods for doing so.

pmc-11490418.title: Evaluating the impact of surgery sequence on infection rates in hip or knee arthroplasty: does sequence matter?
pmc-11490418.creator: Pakpoom Ruangsomboon, Onlak Ruangsomboon, Sebastian Tomescu, Cristal Rahman, Daniel Pincus, Bheeshma Ravi
pmc-11490418.description: PurposeThe potential influence of surgical sequence of elective hip-and-knee reconstructive surgery in relation to an infection-related procedure on postoperative infection rates is not clearly understood. pmc-12893377.title: Development and Validation of a Monte Carlo Beam Model for 6, 8, and 15 MV Clinical Photon Beams on the Elekta™ Precise Linac
pmc-12893377.creator: JJL Smit, Déte Van Eeden, F. C. P. Du Plessis
pmc-12893377.description: Introduction:This study investigates a single-source photon beam model and a single source for contamination electrons for Monte Carlo (MC) simulations. Our approach uses a beam characterization model-to-model clinical photon beams for 6, 8, and 15 MV on a linear accelerator. The flattening filter attenuates the photon fluence in the beam model before reaching the secondary collimation accessories.

pmc-13594899.description: Highlights•Pigeon pea effects on Nellore methane emissions and beef quality were evaluated.•Intercropping reduced methane emission intensity per kg carcass by over 40%.•Pigeon pea intercropping increased stocking rates and final carcass weights.•The system enhanced high-value beef cuts yield without altering meat quality.•Pigeon pea-grass systems are a viable strategy for sustainable beef production.
